summary: Focused retest of the faultMetaLine fix (machine_type is dropped when it equals the title, ignoring case, or when the title came from the type). (1) The iteration_291 node harness passed 612/612, including the 600-combo check for no leading, trailing or double ' | '. (2) New harness tests/fault_title_unit_292.mjs passed 9/9. Model 'Treadmill' + type 'Treadmill' gives 'd'. Technogym SKILLMILL/Treadmill/Inda gives 'Treadmill | Inda | d'. Case-insensitive and whitespace variants, a name equal to the type, and make+model 'Life Treadmill' (which keeps the type) all behave correctly. (3) UI at 390 on /pulse (pulse_pro) and /dashboard (gym) with seeded TEST_ui292 data: 6 cards each showed the right title, small line and meta line. The new edge case (i6) shows title 'Treadmill', 'S/N SN-TM-0006' and meta 'Inda | <date>' with no repeated Treadmill. scrollWidth == innerWidth (390). No email was sent. All TEST_ui292 rows were removed by id, and a count shows 0 left.

issues: Already there before this change: a long org name wraps onto 3 lines next to the logo in the header.

critical_code_review_comments: faultMetaLine compares only issue.machine_type, but faultTitle falls back to machine_type || equipment_type. This is fine, because the meta line only ever shows machine_type.
Minor (carried over): faultTitle is called several times per card. It could be computed once and reused.
